selection: Ten rough light-feature observation boxes ordered top-to-bottom by box top, left-to-right on ties, within fixed ROI. Not an exhaustive component census or all possible assignments.
observer: One assistant visual review, not independent human certification
precision_blocker: Unresolved physical endpoint identity, not absent north/scale/time. Soft/merged contours in right ground further impede finite endpoint localization.
interruption: Executor disconnected during right-ground view; crop files persisted. Harmless availability check failed once; after reconnection files were checked and the right-ground view was completed. No uncertain write or duplicate fit.
catalogue_refresh: Read-only LOC catalogue web request returned403; not retried. Existing source TIFF identity matched the previously verified hash.
